Coram : ADARSH KUMAR GOEL, R.F. NARIMAN
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 – s.19(3)(c) – Held: In view of three judge Bench judgment dtd. 28th March, 2018 passed by Supreme Court in Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency P. Ltd. and Anr. v. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in [2018] 2 SCR 1045, impugned order No.1394/2013 is set aside and the matter is remanded to High Court – Connected appeal Nos. 1384, 1386-1387, 1395 and 10050-10051, dismissed – SLP Crl. No. 5678/14 detagged – SLP Crl. No.9363/17 tagged with SLP Crl. No. 6165/2016 – All other connected appeals/special leave
